tuning.title: Tuning
tuning.extraArgsHint: --flag=value separated by spaces; applied on next launch
cache.title: Game cache
tip.cacheClear: Deletes downloaded maps, module scripts and shaders. Helps when the game shows stale or broken files after a module update. World logins and Foundry settings stay. The first load after clearing takes longer.
err.urlInvalid: Doesn't look like an address. Example: vtt.example.com:30000
err.serverMissing: Server not found — refresh the list
notice.storeCorrupted: {file} was damaged — a .bak copy was kept
notice.engineFallback: WebGL crashed on {from} — engine switched to {to}
notice.launchFailed: The game didn't open. If you just closed it, wait a couple of seconds
tip.resolution: Resolution the map is rendered at. Chat, sheets and Foundry windows stay sharp. With adaptive mode this is the floor: heavy scenes drop down to it, and it climbs back when there is headroom.
tip.maxFps: Frame cap for the map, up to 240. Foundry itself stops at 60 — the client holds higher caps. Going above your monitor's refresh rate is pointless: the browser won't draw more. A lower cap means less load and steadier frames.
tip.unfocused: How many frames to draw while the game window isn't focused (you're in Discord or a browser). Frees the GPU for other apps.
tip.perfMode: Foundry's built-in quality mode: texture resolution, antialiasing, shadow softness. LOW takes a lot off weak GPUs.
tip.adaptive: Watches frame time and lowers map resolution in heavy scenes, then brings it back. The main lever for weak GPUs.
tip.lightAnimation: Flickering torches, pulsing magic lights and other animated light sources. Each one is a separate shader every frame.
tip.visionAnimation: Smoothly recomputes token vision while it moves. When off, vision updates once the token reaches its square.
tip.mipmap: Smooths textures when zoomed far out. Without mipmaps a distant map shimmers, but uses a bit less memory.
tip.pixelRatio: Render the map at Windows display scaling (125%, 150%). On high-DPI monitors that's 1.5–2× more pixels.
tip.uiBlur: Frosted-glass blur behind Foundry windows. Expensive on weak GPUs, especially with many windows open.
tip.sequencer: Sequencer and JB2A animations: spells, hits, effects. Turning off only affects you — other players see everything as usual.
tip.fxmaster: FXMaster weather and effects: rain, snow, fog, particles. Only affects you.
tip.video: Animated backgrounds and tiles (WebM). "Pause unfocused" stops them while you're away; "Static" always shows a still frame.
tip.prime: Prime Performance module settings, if your GM installed it: lighting layer resolution and simplified shaders. Does nothing without the module.
tip.angle: Which graphics API the browser uses to draw the game. D3D11 is the most compatible. Black screen or crashes — try D3D11ON12 or GL. Applies on next launch.
tip.cache: Disk space for server assets. A bigger cache means fewer re-downloads of maps and tokens between sessions.
tip.extraArgs: For experiments: extra Chromium flags. A flag with the same name replaces ours. If something breaks, clear the field.
tip.scope: Where changes are stored: "All servers" is shared; a slot is for that server only, on top of the shared ones.
tip.profile: All levers at once. Manual changes sit on top of the profile and are marked with a dot.
tip.quality: The picture as intended. For powerful GPUs.
tip.balance: Adaptive resolution with the costly extras off. For a GTX 1060 and similar.
tip.potato: Everything for frames: low map resolution, no animations, weather or video.
install.title: Install Foundry Performance
install.lead: A Foundry VTT client that squeezes FPS out of weak GPUs.
install.err.notAbsolute: Enter a full path, for example D:\Games\FoundryPerformance
install.err.root: Don't install to a drive root — pick a folder
install.err.system: That's a Windows system folder — pick another one
install.err.noAccess: No write access to this folder. Pick one in your profile or on another drive
install.err.running: Foundry Performance is running from this folder — close it and try again
install.err.register: Couldn't register the program with Windows
uninstall.title: Uninstall Foundry Performance?
uninstall.lead: The program, its shortcuts and its entry in Windows Apps will be removed.
uninstall.wipe: Also remove my servers, settings and game cache — this can't be undone
uninstall.done: Removed. This window will close by itself.
uninstall.err.running: Foundry Performance is still running — close it and try again
led.unknown: Status appears after the first time you enter the world through the client
update.noNotes: Click to download and install. The app will restart.
update.err.source: Update rejected: the file is not from the official releases
update.err.hash: Update failed verification: the file was damaged in transit
update.err.signature: Update failed the signature check — installation cancelled
update.err.version: Update failed the version check — installation cancelled
update.err.download: Couldn't download the update. Check your connection and try again
update.err.apply: Couldn't replace the program file. Try again
update.err.check: Couldn't check for updates: GitHub is unreachable
version.noNotes: No change list was written for this version.
tip.manual: Your own lever positions from Tuning. Picking a preset resets this server's changes — pick Manual again to bring them back.
knob.globalOverrides: Shared changes for all servers remain — reset them in “Tuning → Scope: All servers”
gpu.title: Graphics card
gpu.advice.software: Update the GPU driver and make sure hardware acceleration isn't turned off in Windows.
gpu.advice.none: Foundry won't run without WebGL2: update the GPU driver.
